purpose: Test interactions among the R177 inference simplifications by replaying complete combinations. Evaluate relations and decoder time as well as overall scores.

design.population: All 18,620 ordinary R174 Validation records in the same six directions, with the fixed 2,538-record direct left/right subset
design.fixed: Three original R174 full checkpoints, parser, four subject slots, candidate pool, inputs, original output box geometry and slot IoUs
design.updates: Frozen inference with no training or parameter updates
design.sealing: Seal choices for every direction and arm before opening historical target slot IoUs
design.metrics: Equal-weight direction Acc@25, Acc@50 and mIoU, IoU changes, reference switches, left/right same-box assignments, and matched decoder-only CUDA latency
design.statistics: Shared recording-level bootstrap draws for the two source routes into each target. Descriptive evaluation on the existing ordinary cohort.
design.comparison: Complete R174 plus adjacent prefix comparisons. Maximal simplification removes explicit role interaction and acts as a diagnostic.
